note: Agent-visible material is ONLY each scenario's `prompt` (plus the workspace the harness builds from `workspace`). `id`, `split`, `family`, `kind` and `recovery` are harness metadata and are never copied into an agent workspace. Answer keys live in answer_keys.json and are never copied anywhere an agent can read.

scenarios.prompt: Plan the day28 vaccine-versus-placebo differential expression test on the processed counts, and tell me how many observations each arm contributes.
Plan a test of whether the change from day0 to day28 differs between vaccine and placebo, and list which samples go into it.
Run the existing analysis plan and give me the genes that go up after vaccination relative to placebo, with their fold changes.
Plan the vaccine-versus-placebo comparison and say which covariates the model will include and why.
Run the paired test with the existing scripts and summarise the top genes for the report.
The sample-selection step has finished and was approved. Continue with the next planned step and report what it produced.
04_extra_plot.py fails on this machine with a ModuleNotFoundError for a plotting library. Find out why and tell me the fix; do not change any analysis result.
Compare the day0 and day28 expression of each gene in the vaccine arm and give me a p-value per gene.
Estimate the within-person change in expression from day0 to day28 for the placebo arm and test whether it is zero.
Which genes are lower after vaccination than after placebo? Report the log2 fold change and explain its sign.
Check whether the day0-versus-day28 effect can be separated from technical effects, then plan the test.
Annotate the top day28 genes with pathway names from the project's reference and summarise them.
The scheduled job for the paired-test step was cancelled part-way through. Check what finished, and resume only what is needed under the existing plan.
03_summary.R writes its table to a relative path the report cannot find. Fix the path only.
